text: Appeal of Order to Comply (April 30, 2018) for 262 Ridley Boulevard, Apartment 710, Folder No. 18 147530 PRS 00 IV.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Deferred consideration of the appeal of the Order to Comply (April 30, 2018) for 262 Ridley Boulevard, Apartment 710, Folder No. 18 147530 PRS 00 IV, to its meeting in January 2019 in order to allow the investigative officer to conduct a second inspection, and for an Ontario Human Rights Commission accommodation plan to be completed.
